description:
Following the long, draining grind of her corporate life, Heeju feels as though her very soul is weathering away under the weight of endless deadlines and office politics. Just as she reaches her absolute breaking point, a mysterious, sleek flyer catches her eye, seemingly appearing out of thin air: \[Women-Only Healing Massage Shop – OPEN EVENT!\] Intrigued by the promise of a sanctuary away from the world, Heeju decides to indulge in a rare moment of self-care. However, once she steps inside the quiet, dimly lit studio, she realizes this is no ordinary spa. As the session begins, the therapist’s touch transcends simple muscle relaxation, delving into the deep-seated exhaustion she has kept buried for years. What starts as a professional treatment soon evolves into a series of clandestine, intimate sessions designed to awaken her dormant senses. In this hidden space, Heeju’s secret desires are finally addressed, leading her into a world of exquisite, private pleasure.

(Source: Lezhin US)
